jurisdiction.venue: Westminster Magistrates' Court & UK Serious Fraud Office (SFO)

headline: Seven Years After £251 Million Mini-Bond Collapse, U.K. Prosecutors Charge Eight in London Capital & Finance Case
deck: The Serious Fraud Office accused former executives and associates of conspiracy to defraud after more than 11,200 retail investors lost savings in 2019. All defendants are presumed innocent.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: Eight individuals criminally charged in £251M (~$318M) retail mini-bond collapse affecting 11,200+ savers; first court appearance scheduled Dec. 7, 2026.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: If proven, the charges would resemble running an unlicensed £25,000 neighborhood investment club that vanishes with deposits
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Charged within months rather than seven years after the collapse

sources.title: SFO charges eight over London Capital & Finance collapse

interactive_art_spec.caption: Westminster Magistrates' Court in London, where eight defendants charged in the London Capital & Finance investigation are scheduled to make their first appearance on Dec. 7, 2026.
